thread:
maria: Heads up — CI smoke for hosted integration is red since the last deploy, blocking PR #4321. Failures clustered around auth + streaming toolcall flows. anyone free to help triage?
ci-bot: smoke-suite: shard=7 FAILED (12/120) — failing tests: integration/auth_stream_toolcall_test::*  (first failure: 401 from /v1/stream)
kevin: I started a quick rerun of shard 7 (`./ci/run_smoke --shard 7 --rerun-failures`) — still failing, same 401s and one test hanging on toolcall response. logs attached in build https://ci.internal/2145 (private)
samir: quick log snippet I grabbed:```
2026-03-16T18:03:12Z ERROR http: POST /v1/stream 401 Unauthorized {"token":"missing"}
2026-03-16T18:03:14Z WARN toolcall: response timeout after 30s
```
olivia: @kevin any recent changes to auth-proxy or token rotation? I recall a canary yesterday: canary-auth-20260316 rolled at 16:20 UTC.
kevin: yes, we deployed a minor fix for header normalization in the proxy. Reverting is painful but we can test against previous image tag `auth-proxy:v20260315` — can someone run the smoke job against that?
maria: I'll kick a targeted run: `./ci/run_smoke --shard 7 --env IMAGE_OVERRIDE=auth-proxy:v20260315` now. will post results.
ops-bot: job queued: smoke-shard7-override-2145679 started by maria (estimated 12m)
kevin: while that's running, quick thought: one of the failing tests also logs a schema validation error when toolcall returns: `Missing required field "tool_payload"` — that could be either tool side or our streaming layer dropping the wrapper.
samir: I can tail the tool side for the failing workflow. grabbing pod logs from tools-prod for run id=run-8789.
ci-bot: smoke-shard7-override-2145679: FAILED after 6m — still 401s.
olivia: ok so override didn't help, so either token propagation path changed (auth-proxy -> runtime) or the client header formation changed. @maria any chance the SDK in the smoke job got bumped?
maria: smoke job uses the release tarball from `main` built at 2026-03-16T15:50; last SDK bump was in that build. I'll open a quick manual curl from the runner: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://hosted.api/v1/stream`
kevin: can you dump the raw headers the runner is sending? if header name changed (Authorization vs authorization) and proxy is strict we might see this.
maria: header dump attached:```
> Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
> Host: hosted.api
> User-Agent: smoke-runner/1.2
```
kevin: hmm looks normal. I'll add temporary logging in the proxy on header casing and token parsing. patching now and will deploy to a test instance (not full canary).
olivia: in parallel, can someone try running the integration with `TOKEN` from a known-good session (from pre-canary) to rule out upstream token revocation?
samir: I have a session cookie from last night. trying handshake... toolcall hangs still for one test but auth passes for the others. copying handshake trace:```
client->runtime: POST /v1/stream (auth ok)
runtime->tools: POST /internal/toolcall (200)
tools->runtime: 502 gateway error (intermittent)
```
maria: so two separate issues: 401 auth for most flows, and a flaky 502 on toolcall. both started ~after canary. this feels like a routing or proxy churn issue.
kevin: agree. plan: 1) revert header normalization patch on auth-proxy in canary and redeploy, 2) add temporary extra logging to catch header passthrough, 3) triage tool 502 with ops on the tool side (Samir).
kevin: asking for hand from oncall — @olivia can you approve a canary revert?
olivia: approving revert for canary-auth-20260316 -> roll back to v20260315. do it during the next 10m window. :thumbsup:
maria: reverted and redeploy started (canary rollback). I'll re-run smoke shard 7 after it finishes.
ops-bot: deploy canary-auth rolled back to auth-proxy:v20260315 by maria — rollout status: started
ci-bot: smoke rerun queued after deploy completion.
kevin: Samir, follow up on tool 502s — can you open a short trace for the 502 occurrence and tag the tool owners?
samir: already pinged tool-owners channel and started a trace, linking trace id trace-5512 in the incident channel.
maria: smoke rerun completed — PASS for auth tests on shard 7, one remaining flaky toolcall test still unstable (2/3 runs flaky).
kevin: great, confirms revert fixed auth. let's keep the revert while we root cause header normalization. I'll keep logs for 24h.
olivia: filing a short postmortem and owner action items: revert persisted, add canary gating for header changes, and add a smoke test that specifically validates header casing and token parsing. I'll draft the doc.
maria: thanks all — unblocking PR #4321. moving to follow-ups for toolcall flake. :wave:
